decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ -0.8%, S&P 500 -0.3%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) sits below the $500 deployment threshold, so per prior lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy into a lukewarm setup — existing positions are left to run and risk controls remain automatic.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted slightly lower today in a session without a strong directional catalyst. With NASDAQ down 0.8% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, the tone was cautious rather than fearful, consistent with a market pausing rather than reversing trend.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢偏軟，納指跌0.8%，標普500跌0.3%，未見明顯利淡消息帶動，整體氣氛審慎但未見恐慌，較似是短暫喘定整固，而非趨勢逆轉。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder means keeping cash on hand rather than investing it immediately, so you have capital ready when a clearly attractive opportunity appears. Today's cash balance is below the threshold needed for a new position, so holding it in reserve — instead of forcing a marginal trade — preserves flexibility for a stronger setup.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指保留現金而不急於投資，待出現真正吸引的機會時才動用資金。今日現金水平未達新開倉的門檻，與其勉強做一筆普通的交易，不如保留彈性，留待更佳時機出手。
